input:
Scene:
古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候，从早到晚一直祭拜，因为他妈妈告诉他祭拜很重要。虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜。他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了。孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响，所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了。

The teacher's corrections on this scene:
- 古代的时候人觉得祭拜非常重要，孟子很小的时候：在古代，人们，“人“ is too general and too vague, and does not stand alone；better to briefly introduce “孟子” when this character first appears
- 虽然他没有朋友，因为每天只祭拜：delete虽然，there is no “even though” meaning here
- 他的同学们老是对他开玩笑了：跟他开玩笑，no了for routine/habit
- 孟子妈妈看了他的同学们对孟子不好的影响：看到，看look vs.看到see; 有不好的影响
- 所以孟子和孟子妈妈搬家了：delete孟子和孟子妈妈, redundant

The system's item in each run:
Run 1: Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：一个叫孟子的小男孩从小就，On a character’s first mention, introduce the character with a full noun phrase rather than using only the name. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
Run 2: Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：有一个小男孩叫孟子。他很小的时候，This is the character’s first mention, so introduce him with a full noun phrase before using a pronoun. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]
Run 3: Coherence (Reference): 孟子很小的时候：有一个叫孟子的小男孩很小的时候，at a character’s first mention, introduce the name together with a full noun phrase that identifies who the character is. [rule: character_introduction_first_mention]

output.reason: All runs identify the first-mention character introduction issue and correctly introduce 孟子 as a little boy.
